caption_L1: Here a bar graph is called Ecuador : National debt from 2014 to 2024 (in billion U.S. dollars). The y-axis plots Year along a categorical scale starting at 2014 and ending at 2024*. There is a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 50 on the x-axis, marked National debt in billion U.S. dollars.
caption_L2L3: The highest level of national debt was in years 2019 and 2020. The lowest level of national debt was in 2014. The level of debt reached a peak in 2019 and 2020, but then began to fall each year going forward. The largest surge in national debt was from 2015 to 2016, where the debt rose by just under ten million dollars.
